diagnostic_events.detail: POST-F1: independent outer/inner paths and hashes. Original f13 result binds outer; exact outer GUI command/Node, reviewed runner pin and inner scope input pin bind inner; runner result binds inner hash. Stop proof precedes qualification receipt reads.
POST-F2: Plan and START/RESULT/COMPLETE keys and access now match pinned production lowercase JSON tags. Exact keys, bytes, case order, values and bitmap remain checked.

POST-F3: explicit null or zero-length array permitted only in empty-slice positions. Required property checks reject omission. Final case_results remains the exact seven-row array; nonempty findings remain rejected.

raw_limit_assessment.detail: Pinned f13 selects UNKNOWN_OR_LAUNCH_FAILED on errors/unproved stop, then OUTPUT_LIMIT_STOPPED when raw_limit_exceeded, before selecting COMPLETED_OWNED_JOB_STOPPED. Therefore accepted authentic completed/no-error results already exclude overflow. No source blocker or mandatory extra boolean test was added. This relies on the pinned original controller evidence; a future controller change needs review.

source_review.manifest: Manifest and all six declared artifact hashes independently match.
source_review.import_safety: Only builtin imports, constants and function declarations at module top level. Entry guard compares argv[1] to verifier path. The Node test imports exported pure validators and does not enter verify() or open actual qualification files.
source_review.receipt_boundary: No directory scan; fixed receipt paths derive from bound Run/epoch. Root original Job stop is checked before capture/intent/raw receipt access. Paths, Task/Run/boot/source/native/helper/build/template/env/plan/argv, seven outcomes, controls and stream/Job checks retain prior reviewed constraints.
source_review.template: Status and null live pins remain fail-closed. No live scope prepared by reviewer.
source_review.future_outer_contract: Resolved actual outer scope must use purpose gui, cwd equal to reviewed controller directory, exact six runner argv tokens, matching Node image pin, exactly one matching inner-scope input and reviewed runner input.

actual_pure_test.duplicate_note: Requirements JSON appears twice with an identical matched pin; no conflict.
case_names: distinct outer and inner scopes bind the original f13 argv and both input pins
original f13 stopped Job proof gates a simulated receipt read
actual lowercase plan wire keys, nonce, paths and canonical bytes are required
lowercase ordered START/RESULT/COMPLETE transcript binds seven exact results
nil empty slices are phase-specific and final seven finite cases remain strict
qualification PID, configured Job, clean drain and raw hashes are jointly bound
actual_pure_test.coverage_limit: Six pure validator groups, including negative mutations and a simulated read counter. No complete verify() filesystem integration, real receipt set, App/Native/helper/model invocation, or live qualification was performed. Full call ordering and required property gates were statically reviewed.

runtime_prerequisites: Independently reviewed actual Source3/build and original outer/inner/runner evidence; no live binding inferred from fixture PASS.

Fresh exact post-stop scope with independently reviewed current Host boot/source/build/template/environment/argv provenance; copying those values from the receipt alone is not independent verification.
Actual use only after original Job stop. Validate finite qualification evidence on that bound process/time; do not grant READY, global permission proof or model retry.

review_limits.reviewer_execution: No tests, verifier entrypoint/import, App, helper, Native/CLI/model or Go executed by reviewer. Only read-only static/receipt/hash inspection and new C reports.
